{0}体をまとめて攻撃し、{1}へ戻る: Strike {0} at once, then return to {1}
{0}手で時間切れ ・ 残HPの多い方の勝ち: Time up at {0} moves · the side with more HP wins
動くと後ろの{0}が撃たれる: Move and the {0} behind is hit
部屋 {0} を再開しました。相手が入り直すと続きから対戦できます: Room {0} resumed. When your opponent rejoins you can carry on
1体で2体以上を狙える形。その駒を選んで再タップするとForkモードになり、狙え: A shape where one piece threatens two or more. Select it and tap again for Fork mode: it strikes the two most valuable targets in turn, then returns to its square
2マス進んで真横に来た相手のポーンは、その直後だけ斜め前へ進んで取れる。: An enemy pawn that has just stepped two squares to land beside yours can be taken, for that one move only, by stepping diagonally forward.
2体で同時にキングを狙うとDouble Check。成立した瞬間、キングに200: Two pieces threatening the king at once is Double Check. The moment it forms, the king takes 200 damage.
2体以上を狙える形がFork。Forkモードなら、1手で2体へ続けて攻撃して元の: Threatening two or more is a Fork. In Fork mode, one turn strikes two in succession and returns to the starting square.
Homecomingは1試合に1回、自陣の最下段の空きマスへ瞬間移動する。: Once per match, Homecoming teleports the king to an empty square on its own back rank.
Sanctuaryは周り2マス以内の傷ついた味方1体を120回復する。ビショップ: Sanctuary heals one wounded ally within two squares for 120. The bishop does not move.
キングの周り1マス（Awakening中は2マス）にいる味方の攻撃が強くなる: Allies within one square of the king (two while Awakening) attack harder
キングもルークもまだ動いておらず、間に駒がない時、キングが2マス横へ進み、ルーク: When neither the king nor the rook has moved and nothing stands between them, the king steps two squares sideways and the rook leaps over to the far side
キングもルークも動いておらず、間が空いていればCastling。キングが2マス動: If neither the king nor the rook has moved and the space between is clear, Castling is available. The king moves two squares and the rook leaps over to the far side.
クイーンの周り1マスにいる敵の攻撃が弱くなる。敵が範囲にいる時だけ足元に四角が回: Enemies within one square of the queen attack weaker. A square turns at her feet only while an enemy is in range
ビショップが1体目を倒すと、同じ直線の次の敵にも半分のダメージが入る。: When the bishop kills the first target, the next enemy on the same line takes half damage.
ポーンが成った瞬間に発動：成った駒のHPが全回復する／ポーンの時に歩いたマス数が: Fires the moment a pawn promotes: the new piece is fully healed, and the squares it walked as a pawn are added to its power from then on
ルールブックを3D化。技22個すべてに盤の上で再生するデモを追加: Rulebook rebuilt in 3D. Every one of the 22 skills now has a demo that plays on the board
余ったダメージが相手の最大HPの半分以上ある一撃で倒すとオーバーキル。ナイト・ポ: A kill where the leftover damage is at least half the target's max HP is an Overkill. Knights, pawns and kings come down from directly above like a meteor; queens, rooks and bishops dive in head first like a missile and shatter the target completely
余ったダメージが相手の最大HPの半分以上ならOverkill。Spoilsの回復: If the leftover damage is at least half the target's max HP it is an Overkill, and Spoils heals 50% instead.
周り2マス以内（5×5）にいる傷ついた味方1体を回復。ビショップは動かない: Heals one wounded ally within two squares (5×5). The bishop does not move
味方がキングだけになった瞬間に発動し、自分の手番8回ぶんだけ続く：威力2倍／会心: Fires the moment the king is the only piece left, and lasts eight of your turns: double power, 30% critical rate, half damage taken, 150 struck back at anyone who leaves it alive, immunity to Pin, Tempest, Stampede, Skewer and Double Check damage, 60 healed if it was not hit since its last turn, Spoils at 50%, and nearby enemies at Power -1. After eight turns the light goes out and it is an ordinary king again, max HP back to 1200
味方に囲まれたキングをナイトで倒すとSmothered Mate。: Taking a king walled in by its own pieces with a knight is a Smothered Mate.
味方の長距離駒の道を開けると、その駒の次の攻撃が力+1になる。: Clearing the line for your own long-range piece gives its next attack Power +1.
手前の敵の後ろにもっと価値の高い敵がいる形がPin。手前が動くと、後ろの駒が距離: A Pin is a shape with a more valuable enemy standing behind a nearer one. If the near piece moves, the one behind takes distance × 60 damage.
指した後、自分の駒で相手のキングを攻撃できる状態。負けにはならない: A state where, after your move, one of your pieces can strike the enemy king. It is not a loss
指した後に相手のキングを攻撃できる状態がCheck。このゲームでは負けにはならな: Check is when, after your move, you can strike the enemy king. It is not a loss here, but it puts the weight of the next blow on them.
敵陣側で味方ポーンに斜め後ろから守られているナイトの攻撃が強くなる: A knight on the enemy's side, guarded from diagonally behind by a friendly pawn, attacks harder
最下段のキングをルークかクイーンで倒すとBack Rank Mate。: Taking a king on the back rank with a rook or queen is a Back Rank Mate.
最低ダメージでも倒せる一撃がCheckmate。専用の決着演出が入る。: A blow that kills even on its lowest roll is Checkmate, and it gets a finishing sequence of its own.
最奥に着くとクイーンに成る。同時にAscensionが発動して全回復し、歩いた距: Reaching the far rank promotes it to a queen. Ascension fires at the same time: a full heal, and the distance walked is added to its power.
無料版で遊べるのは「オフライン・やさしい」とパズル、そして友だちの部屋への参加で: The free version gives you Offline on Easy, the puzzles, and joining a friend's room.
相手との接続が切れました。相手が同じ部屋番号で入り直せば再開できます: Lost the connection. If your opponent rejoins with the same room key you can carry on
相手のポーンが2マス進んで自分のポーンの真横に来た直後だけ、斜め前へ進んでそのポ: Only immediately after an enemy pawn steps two squares to land beside yours can you step diagonally forward and strike it
盾に駒を据え、昇格のたびに外側へ意匠が一枚ずつ増える。段位は盾下のバッジの数。: A piece sits on the shield, and each promotion adds another layer of ornament around it. The tier is the number of badges below the shield.
移動でも、敵を倒して最奥のマスに入った時でも成る。成った瞬間にAscension: It promotes whether it walks onto the far rank or kills its way there. Ascension fires the moment it does
縦横の直線上にいる最初の敵を光線で撃ち抜く。倒してもルークは動かない: Fires a beam through the first enemy on a straight line. The rook stays put even if it kills
製品版にすると、ふつう／つよい／ランクマッチと、部屋を作って友だちを誘うことが開: The full version unlocks Normal, Hard, Ranked, and creating a room to invite a friend.
長距離駒の直線上で、手前の敵の後ろにより価値の高い敵がいる形。手前の駒が動くと、: On a long-range piece's line, a shape with a more valuable enemy behind a nearer one. If the near piece moves, the one behind takes damage
長距離駒の真後ろに同じ方向へ動ける味方がいると、前の駒の攻撃が力+2になる。: With an ally that moves the same way directly behind it, the front long-range piece attacks at Power +2.
長距離駒の真後ろに同じ方向へ動ける味方の長距離駒がいると、前の駒の攻撃が強くなる: With a friendly long-range piece that moves the same way directly behind it, the front piece attacks harder
駒をどかして後ろの味方の長距離駒の道を開けると、その駒の次の攻撃が強くなる。敵の: Move a piece out of the way to clear the line for your long-range piece behind it, and that piece's next attack is stronger. Clearing an enemy's line does not help them
